child.label: Empathy & Social Reading
child.description: Questions about noticing and caring about other people's feelings, reading social situations, and showing affection.
child.not_for: How the answerer handles and expresses their own emotions (use Coping & Expressing Emotions); past-week stress or mood symptoms (use Recent Stress & Mood); mindful awareness of your own feelings and senses (use Mindfulness & Self-Awareness).
examples: Does seeing people cry upset you?
Can you easily tell when someone is bored with what you are saying?

right_away / wait_until_calm

When you have had a terrible day, what helps you most?
other / Sleeping it off / Writing it down / Exercise / Time alone / A show or game to distract you / Talking to someone

When you are angry at someone, what do you usually do?
other / Avoid them for a while / Keep it inside / Vent to someone else / Cool down, then talk / Tell them right away

When you are sad, do you prefer company or to be left alone?
alone / company / depends

How do you usually act under heavy pressure, like a tight deadline?
Avoid the task / other / Freeze up / Become frantic but get it done / Get calm and focused

Where are you most likely to cry?
Only when alone / Almost never cry / other / At movies or books / Anywhere when it hits / In front of people you trust

When a friend is upset, which do you notice first?
Their body language / Their face / Their tone of voice / What they say / You often miss it

After an argument, how long does it usually take you to calm down?
About a day / A few hours / Much longer / A few minutes

When you get bad news by text, what is your first move?
other / Keep busy right away / Sit with it quietly / Call someone / Look for a solution

Which feeling do you find hardest to show to others?
joy / fear / anger / sadness / affection / embarrassment

When someone criticizes your work harshly, how do you respond in the moment?
other / Go quiet / Get teary / Argue back / Make a joke / Stay composed

How openly do you show your feelings at work or school?
You hide them completely / You show only small hints / You show them when they are strong / People can always tell exactly how you feel

child.label: Coping & Expressing Emotions
child.description: Questions about how the answerer handles and shows their own emotions, such as anger, crying, venting, calming down, and dealing with stress or bad news.
child.not_for: Reading other people's feelings (use Empathy & Social Reading); how much stress or low mood you had in the past week (use Recent Stress & Mood).
examples: Do you feel better after venting to someone?

child.label: Recent Stress & Mood
child.description: Questions about how much the answerer felt anxiety, tension, low mood, or hopelessness over the past week.
child.not_for: Lasting habits of handling or expressing emotion (use Coping & Expressing Emotions).
examples: Did you find it hard to wind down this past week?
Did you feel sad and depressed this past week?

child.label: Mindfulness & Self-Awareness
child.description: Questions about paying attention to the present moment, noticing bodily sensations and feelings, putting feelings into words, and judging your own thoughts.
child.not_for: Handling or expressing emotions (use Coping & Expressing Emotions); reading other people's feelings (use Empathy & Social Reading).
examples: Do you notice the sensations of water in the shower?
Do you tell yourself you shouldn't feel the way you feel?
